profile.headline: Enterprise Data Product Owner
profile.ethos_headline: I build the data infrastructure that makes decisions possible.
profile.ethos_summary: At the intersection of product thinking and data engineering — translating messy, multi-source enterprise data into clean, governed, decision-ready systems that actually get used.

highlights.title: Systems thinker
highlights.body: I see data warehouses not as technology projects but as products — with consumers, SLAs, and feedback loops. Every pipeline I build has an owner and a purpose before it has a schema.

highlights.title: Bridge builder
highlights.body: I've spent my career translating between two worlds — business stakeholders who know what they need and engineering teams who know how to build it. User stories with real acceptance criteria are my native language.

highlights.title: Delivery-focused
highlights.body: Strategy without shipping is just a slide deck. From a $6M payroll portal to federal regulatory automation to national fundraising platforms — I measure success in systems that run in production.
Industries: Real estate · Banking · Nonprofit · InsureTech

highlights.title: 8yr
highlights.body: Delivering data and product in enterprise environments

highlights.title: Data architecture
highlights.body: Medallion lakehouse design (bronze/silver/gold), source-to-target mapping, surrogate key strategy, data quality frameworks

highlights.title: Product ownership
highlights.body: Agile ceremonies, PI planning, roadmap ownership, acceptance criteria, UAT — across teams of 5 to 200+ peers

highlights.title: Platform delivery
highlights.body: Databricks, Snowflake, Azure, AWS, GCP — migrations, integrations, and operational stability at enterprise scale

highlights.title: AI & emerging tech
highlights.body: Vertex AI multi-modal agents, LLaVA local models, Gemini, Claude, CoPilot — applied practitioner, not just theorist
